description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 or 3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [ATK and MND +50% (25s)] or [MAG and MND +50% (25s)] to the user, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Vincent)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode I (Vincent)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Fire abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Fire abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Vincent)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Fire Mode II (Vincent)
description.text: Fire abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Fire abilities, grants [Chaos Form MAG Boost] if the user's MAG >= ATK after using Fire abilities, grants [Chaos Form ATK Boost] if the user's MAG < ATK after using Fire abilities

description.name: Chaos Form MAG Boost
description.text: MAG, DEF and RES +50%, increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, instant cast speed

description.name: Chaos Form ATK Boost
description.text: ATK, DEF and RES +50%, increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, instant cast speed

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
